title: cyperus ferax var. engelmannii
intro: Cyperus ferax var. engelmannii, commonly known as Engelmann's flatsedge, is a type of sedge plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Engelmann's flatsedge include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and exhibit antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
